zh: 新增合集功能、日历视图与合密专用版本，并完成 0.27.0 API 适配。
继续优化图片压缩、剪藏与导航手势体验，同时清理 Apple 平台脚手架。
修复编辑图片预览变形、Tag 排序无法保存与桌面端多账户切换失败等问题。
en: Added collections, a calendar view, a dedicated HeMi build, and compatibility with API 0.27.0.
Continued improving image compression, clipping, and navigation or gesture interactions, while removing Apple platform scaffolding.
Fixed distorted image previews during editing, unsaved tag sorting, and failed multi-account switching on desktop.

zh: 改进图片压缩流程与相关性能表现
优化剪藏流程，增加顶部平台识别
移除 Apple 平台脚手架
en: Improved the image compression pipeline and related performance.
Optimized clipping and added top platform detection.

zh: 修复编辑图片时预览图变形
修复 Tag 排序无法保存
修复桌面端多账户切换失败
en: Fixed distorted image previews while editing.
Fixed tag sorting not being saved.
